variations.name: Valencia stack
variations.tagline: The model's best plan: coach Albert (PAM), the round's biggest favourite, plus Armoni Brooks from the same game, with Bryant and Vezenkov carrying the ceiling.

trades.why: Valencia (first, 9-3) host Virtus at 85% on the site with a projected +10 margin. Olympiacos–Madrid is 68%, and Bartzokas costs 1.6 more.
Feliz is on a back-to-back with Maledon back. Brooks scored 15 against Partizan and 25 in 19' in the ACB, with Mirotić and Reuvers out. [dom: ACB 15 Nov vs Coruña 18.9' PIR 19, acb.com]
Rogkavopoulos played 6' on his return. Frisch has started with Sedekerskis out: 7 PIR in 21' against Hapoel, at Bayern on Thursday. [dom: ACB 15 Nov vs Real Madrid 12.6' PIR −2, acb.com]
Pure funding for the last bench slot (50%). Procida is on a back-to-back at Olympiacos. Joksimović didn't score against Hapoel, so expect little. [dom: ACB 15 Nov vs Real Madrid 14.5' PIR 4, acb.com]

variations.captain_note: Vezenkov at home to Madrid on Friday (41 PIR on Tuesday) is the biggest ceiling. Bryant, on Thursday at Paris, is the early armband.
variations.captain_plan: Armband on Bryant Thursday. Keep it if he scores 28+, otherwise move it to Vezenkov before Friday 21:15.
reasoning: About 6% chance of 200 (1 in 16), the model's top plan, against about 5% standing still. All 4 trades are for R13 only, because the window resets everything before R14.
Correlation: Albert (PAM) and Brooks boom together if Valencia run away from Virtus. You hold no Virtus player, so nothing pulls against it.
Coach lens: Paris–Hapoel is the fastest game of the round, and Bryant is Hapoel's engine (two 35-PIR nights in his last five).
Cheap upside watch: Frisch (starter with Sedekerskis out) takes Rogkavopoulos's bench slot. Kamenjas, the biggest role jump, already starts at center.
The Procida → Joksimović trade costs PIR on the 4th bench slot only. It's the price of Brooks.
cancel_if: If Joksimović isn't in Baskonia's squad for Bayern, make trade 4 Procida → Cavaliere (PRS, 4.0) instead (bank 0.5).
If a bookmaker line has Valencia under −6, keep Bartzokas (OLY) and do Feliz → Rj Cole (MIL, 9.0) instead of Brooks.

rumours.text: Konchar has left the club; Montero is out for about 6 months; Milutinov (broken finger) has no return date; Dorsey's status is unclear after his suspension.
rumours.impact: Even more usage for Vezenkov (39' and 41 PIR at Maccabi). Ward and Joseph get the wing and guard minutes. Bartzokas (OLY) is a correlation pick, not a value pick.

rumours.text: Mike James is out for the season (Achilles), Bruno Fernando for 3–4 weeks (calf), and Cordinier is still out.
rumours.impact: Payne and Malcolm carry the offence. Saric is the only big who gets real minutes. Laso (IST) at home to ASVEL is the coach pick.

rumours.text: Barça agreed a deal with Killian Hayes (NBA opt-out) to cover a guard room with Punter, Gibson and Evbuomwan out.
rumours.impact: Not registered yet. Once he is, Robinson and Brizuela lose some minutes; R13 is unaffected.

rumours.text: Chris Silva is set to take Lauvergne's EuroLeague spot. Thompson and Hayes are out, Willis is doubtful.
rumours.impact: Marinković keeps his starts (27.7' on Tuesday). Jekiri's minutes may fall a little once Silva arrives.

rumours.text: 1-11. Faried (hamstring, weeks), Santos (calf) and Sedekerskis (thigh) are out. Kamenjas is on loan from Dubai, and Howard left for Zenit in October.
rumours.impact: Kamenjas and Len share the center minutes, with Kamenjas starting. Frisch and Kurucs get the forward minutes. Perasović (BAS) is no coach pick.

players.name: Sasha Vezenkov
players.read: 41 PIR in 39.5' at Maccabi (37 pts, a half-court shot to force OT). With Milutinov and Montero out and Konchar gone, he is the whole offence. Home to Real Madrid on Friday: I agree with the site's 21.5 as a floor, and a 30+ ceiling is very live. Sport-fm notes the starters' fatigue, but there's no rest talk. [dom: GBL 15 Nov at Aris 35' PIR 21, esake.gr]

players.name: Justin Robinson
players.read: 16 PIR in 27' against Paris, five straight starts. With Punter (late Dec), Gibson (3 weeks) and Evbuomwan out, Barça have two fit guards. Home to Zvezda (site 64%). Agree with 15.3, with upside. [dom: ACB 15 Nov vs Obradoiro 15' PIR 9, acb.com]

players.name: Kenan Kamenjas
players.read: The call paid off: he started his EuroLeague debut, 31', 12 pts, 12 reb, PIR 19. With Faried and Santos out he's Baskonia's starting center at Bayern on Thursday. At 4.8 he's the best bench value in the squad. [dom: ACB 15 Nov vs Real Madrid 24' PIR 22, acb.com]

players.name: Andres Feliz
players.read: Plays tonight at Beşiktaş as Madrid's only fit point guard (Campazzo out), then on Friday at Olympiacos on a back-to-back, with Maledon back. Sell after tonight for Brooks (A) or Maledon (B). [dom: ACB 15 Nov at Baskonia 24' PIR 27, acb.com]

window_plan: Unlimited trades before R14. The rebuild's best plan sells Robinson, Payne, Procida and Diop for Diarra, Frisch, Llull and Maledon, with coach Bartzokas (OLY): about 5.8% a round over R14–R16, against about 4.9% for this squad. That's a small edge, because the draft squad is already close to the model's best. A already brings Frisch in. I'd add Diarra in the window (19 PIR per game in under 20 minutes) and Maledon only if he gets through tonight and Friday at full minutes. Nothing needs buying before the window.
